conf.description: syslog-relay, rsyslog-impstats, syslog-kv (format=legacy): hand-built BSD-syslog header regex + counter-blob kvp extract; dotted counter keys (discarded.full, discarded.nf, suspended.duration, ratelimit.discarded) read via __e[...] bracket access, not rename, since kvp extraction creates them as flat dotted field names that rename would mis-resolve as nested.

conf.comment: syslog-relay/rsyslog-impstats/syslog-kv. format="legacy" impstats line ("<name>: k=v k=v ...") never emits origin, so the (origin,name) keying and reject-if-no-origin guard the json sibling pipeline uses are impossible here - the single strongest reason to move every concentrator to format="json" (see README). Hand-built header regex owns the whole parse (no Cribl pack/Elastic integration exists for impstats). Dotted counter keys (discarded.full, discarded.nf, suspended.duration, ratelimit.discarded) are read via __e[...] bracket access and deleted with a code function, per the dotted-source-key trap. Delta-vs-previous-interval differencing and the zero-default are NOT implemented - both need per-(host,origin,name) state with no verified conf shape, and this format has no origin to key on anyway; counters cross as raw cumulative values (README gap). A colon inside an object name (e.g. a listener spec) will split wrong - also documented, not fixable without a confirmed sample.

functions.description: identify technology, dataset, format, and parsing approach; record the legacy-format limitations up front
split the BSD syslog header (pri, timestamp, hostname, the fixed rsyslogd-pstats tag) from the impstats message body
split the counter block's object name (main Q, imuxsock, an action name, a listener spec) from its space-separated key=value counter list
extract the key=value counter pairs into top-level fields; dotted keys (discarded.full, discarded.nf, suspended.duration, ratelimit.discarded) land as literal flat field names, not nested objects
convert the numeric-looking counter strings (and pri) to actual numbers before they're read/renamed

read the dotted counter keys and pri with bracket access (before rename, and before they are deleted) and tag event.dataset; no zero-default is applied here since the legacy format has no origin to safely gate it on

conf.code: delete __e['msg']; delete __e['counters']; delete __e['pri']; delete __e['discarded.full']; delete __e['discarded.nf']; delete __e['suspended.duration']; delete __e['ratelimit.discarded'];

functions.description: drop parsing scratch fields and the raw dotted-key duplicates now that their values were copied into rsyslog.stats.* by eval; rename cannot remove these (dotted keys resolve as nested paths to rename/eval.remove)
batch-rename the header fields and every non-dotted counter (all valid flat JS identifiers) to their ECS/custom target
Re-nest flat dotted keys (data-maps canonical step)
